The complete proof alone does not supply this spatial explanation.

correction: Append final Remarks with two representative forward cohort characteristics, fixed observation time, diagonal separator and renewal boundary; preserve all original carrier bytes.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Time-age half-plane with horizontal time and vertical age; fixed time t>0, initial-cohort age a_o>t and newborn age 0<a_b<t.
diagram_math_checks.check: The old segment runs from (0,a_o-t) to (t,a_o); the drawn coordinates (0,1.2) to (3.6,4.8) have equal time/age increments. The newborn segment runs from (t-a_b,0) to (t,a_b); the drawn coordinates (1.4,0) to (3.6,2.2) also have equal increments. Both arrows point forward in time with da/dt=1.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Local definition gives a prime = 1 and a(s)=a(0)+s; theorem proof step 1.1 supplies both characteristic origins.

diagram_math_checks.check: The old segment lies strictly above a=t because a-time=1.2>0; the newborn lies below because a-time=-1.4<0. The dashed ray starts at (0,0) with equal increments and separates the two regions. Caption retains a>=t assignment and asserts no initial/boundary compatibility at the corner.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Statement branch split and proof step 5.1; definition of mild solution uses a>=t versus 0<=a<t.
